title: Medical Hardship Liability Cap — Asset Increment for Documented Liquid Savings
content:
### Rule

Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), the asset increment of a Medical Hardship award's hardship liability cap follows the documented liquid assets recorded on the case and the bank statement accepted on the case (the latest accepted when several are), and is measured against the full-percent cap — the tier's hardship liability cap percent of the annual household income recorded on the case, rounded half-up to the cent. The increment is added to the cap last.

| Documented liquid assets | Bank statement accepted fewer than 90 days before the approval day | Raised cap |
|---|---|---|
| above 12000.00 | yes | the full-percent cap plus 25 percent of the assets above 8000.00, that part rounded half-up to the cent |
| above 12000.00 | no | the larger of the full-percent cap and 10 percent of the assets, rounded half-up to the cent |
| above 8000.00 and at most 12000.00 | either | the larger of the full-percent cap and 10 percent of the assets, rounded half-up to the cent |
| at most 8000.00 | either | the full-percent cap as it stands |

The asset increment is the raised cap less the full-percent cap.

### Cases (hypothetical; full-percent cap 900.00)

- Assets 20000.00, statement accepted 30 days before approval: raise of 25 percent of 12000.00, that is 3,000.00; increment 3,000.00.
- Assets 20000.00, statement accepted 90 days before approval: 10 percent of 20000.00 is 2,000.00, more than 900.00; increment 1,100.00.
- Assets 8500.00: 10 percent is 850.00, not more than 900.00; increment 0.00.
- Assets 8000.00: increment 0.00.
